name: ro-array-sanity-jitter
description: Array-level transient-noise sanity check: four separately-supplied 5-stage rings of the shipped delay cell, XOR-combined. Per-ring period and jitter accumulation, XOR-node swing, per-ring and tree supply current, all from one run.
tstep: 1p (print step; ngspice's own LTE and the trnoise breakpoints at vn_dt set the actual solver step)
noise_params: per-stage trnoise( NA=2.2361e-3 NT=1e-11 NALPHA=0 NAMP=0 ) -> injected white PSD 1e-16 V^2/Hz (1e-08 V/sqrt(Hz)), 5 sources per ring, 20 in total
analyses: tran 1p 70n
meas tran t1a when v(x1)=0 rise=2
meas tran t1b when v(x1)=0 rise=18
meas tran t2a when v(x2)=0 rise=2
meas tran t2b when v(x2)=0 rise=18
meas tran t3a when v(x3)=0 rise=2
meas tran t3b when v(x3)=0 rise=18
meas tran t4a when v(x4)=0 rise=2
meas tran t4b when v(x4)=0 rise=18
meas tran c1a find v(q1) when v(x1)=0 rise=2
meas tran c1b find v(q1) when v(x1)=0 rise=18
meas tran c4a find v(q4) when v(x4)=0 rise=2
meas tran c4b find v(q4) when v(x4)=0 rise=18
meas tran cta find v(qt) when v(x1)=0 rise=2
meas tran ctb find v(qt) when v(x1)=0 rise=18
meas tran vhi max v(ro1) from=30n to=65n
meas tran vlo min v(ro1) from=30n to=65n
meas tran vxhi max v(xo) from=30n to=65n
meas tran vxlo min v(xo) from=30n to=65n
let tc = vector(17)
let k = 2
while k <= 18
meas tran tk when v(x1)=0 rise=$&k
let tc[k-2] = tk
let k = k + 1
end
let nper = 16
let nstg = 5
let cq = 1e-9
let tbar = (tc[16] - tc[0])/16
